title: CanAI open-source local canvas studio released with fal.ai integration
summary: CanAI launched as an open-source local studio featuring an infinite canvas for image and video workflows, macro nodes, prompt assistance, a web demo, and Windows release binaries requiring a user-supplied fal.ai key.
research_notes:
Test canvas interaction and node grouping in the web demonstration before installing desktop software.

Download the packaged Windows executable release or clone the repository to run the studio locally.

Configure a personal fal.ai API key in settings to enable neural image and video generation on canvas nodes.

Arrange reference images, connect macro nodes, and execute generations directly across the infinite canvas.

Use macro nodes to bundle repetitive prompt assistance and reference transformations into reusable workflow blocks.

Verify node connection logic in the browser demo before initiating billed generation runs through fal.ai.

Monitor fal.ai account usage limits and API token balances directly when executing high-resolution image and video batches.
